## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library("TCGAbiolinks")
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
library("dplyr")
library("readr")
library("stringr")
```

## Create data directories

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
raw_data_dir <- here(file.path("data", 
                               "_raw"))

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
  dir.create(data_dir)
}

if (!dir.exists(raw_data_dir)) {
  dir.create(raw_data_dir)
}
```

To compute the TPM for each gene, download the gene annotation GDC.h38 GENCODE v36 GTF for fetching gene lengths later.

```{r}
gtf_url <- "https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/be002a2c-3b27-43f3-9e0f-fd47db92a6b5"
gtf_file <- "gencode.v36.annotation.gtf.gz"
gtf_path <- file.path(raw_data_dir,
                      gtf_file)
```

### Queue The Cancer Genome Atlas for count and clinical data

```{r}
data_query <- GDCquery(
  project = "BEATAML1.0-COHORT",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
  access = "open")
```

```{r}
clinical_raw <- GDCquery_clinic(
  project = "BEATAML1.0-COHORT",
  type = "clinical"
) |> 
  as_tibble(.name_repair = make.unique)
```

Filter query based on the manifest, and store query for later mapping between count and clinical data

```{r}
query_result <- getResults(data_query)

data_query$results[[1]] <- query_result |> 
  filter(id %in% manifest_ids)

sample_map_raw <- data_query$results[[1]] |> 
  as_tibble()
```

### Download data

If data files is already downloaded GDCdownload handels it and wont download it again.

```{r}
if (nrow(data_query$results[[1]]) == length(manifest_ids)) {
  GDCdownload(query = data_query,
              directory = raw_data_dir)
} else {
  cat("Mismatch in size between filtered query and MANIFEST ids provided.")
}
```

GDCdownload creates a file called MANIFEST.txt in the current working directory. Move it to data/\_raw. If the file already exists overwrite it.

```{r}
if (file.exists("MANIFEST.txt")) {
  file.rename("MANIFEST.txt", 
              file.path(raw_data_dir,
                        "MANIFEST.txt"))
}
```

```{r}
options(timeout = 600)

if (!file.exists(gtf_path)) {
  download.file(gtf_url,
                destfile = gtf_path,
                mode = "wb")
}
```

### Read data

```{r}
GDC_path <- file.path(raw_data_dir,
                      data_query$project,
                      gsub(" ", "_", data_query$data.category),
                      gsub(" ", "_", data_query$data.type))

dataset_paths <- list.files(path = GDC_path,
                            recursive = TRUE,
                            full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
raw_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = dataset_paths,
                          comment = "#",
                          id = "file",
                          show_col_types = FALSE)

raw_gtf <- readr::read_tsv(file = gtf_path,
                           comment = "#",
                           show_col_types = FALSE,
                           col_names = c("chr",
                                         "source",
                                         "feature",
                                         "start",
                                         "end",
                                         "score",
                                         "strand",
                                         "frame",
                                         "attr"),
                           col_types = "cccddcccc")
```

## Write data file

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(raw_df,
                 file.path(data_dir,
                           "01_dat_load.tsv.gz"))

readr::write_tsv(clinical_raw, 
                 file.path(data_dir, 
                           "01_clin_load.tsv.gz"))

readr::write_tsv(sample_map_raw, 
                 file.path(data_dir,
                           "01_sample_map_load.tsv.gz"))

readr::write_tsv(raw_gtf,
                 file.path(data_dir,
                           "01_gtf_load.tsv.gz"))
```
